mt19937.description: first 16 raw uint32 outputs of MT19937 init_genrand(seed) = numpy.random.RandomState(seed)

payload.description: payload C = RS(30)(be16(len) || M || S), S = Ed25519(sk, M); stream = h h h || b^r (spec §4-5); stream_hex packs the stream MSB first, zero-padded to whole bytes

rs.description: reedsolo RSCodec(30) over GF(2^8) (prim 0x11d, generator 2, fcr 0); each error XORs a nonzero byte at the listed position
